title: Contingency Provisioning Matrix — Heterogeneous Node Plan
summary: Working sheet for planning spare capacity, swap windows, and procurement staging across regions for a heterogeneous GPU fleet in private/VPC deployments. Focused on contingency hedging (surge + hardware failures) rather than steady-state rightsize. Outputs: regional provisioning matrix, phased BOM estimate, and operational swap/runbook checklist.
assumptions:
1) Target SLOs: p50 latency <= 80ms, p95 <= 250ms for interactive lanes; batch lanes allowed higher latency.
2) Workloads: 60% chat/generation, 30% embeddings/semantic search, 10% offline/queued inference.
3) Utilization bands: Normal 65% avg, Surge planning up to 95% across burst windows.
4) Fleet is heterogeneous: A100-80GB (high-throughput), H200-80GB (cost-optimized), L40x-48GB (edge/regional), with mixed NVLink availability.
5) Spare/redundant policy: Hot spares equal to 5% of active capacity + region-specific surge buffer (see matrix).
input_metrics:
Metrics pulled in for initial sizing (placeholder values):
- Peak QPS (global): 210k requests/day -> peak 1100 rps
- Token distribution: mean 40 tokens/request, 75th perc 120 tokens/request
- Average KV-cache hit rate: 18% (saves ~14% tokens)
- Historical failure rate: 0.25% node-day (used for spare rotation calc)
- Region splits (east-us / west-eu / apac): 55% / 30% / 15%
workload_profiles:
Interactive Lanes: low latency, require lowest-tail p95. Prefer A100-80GB with tiny-batch high-priority scheduling.
Cost-Optimized Lanes: higher batching, tolerate 2-3x latency. Prefer H200 with dynamic quantization.
Edge/Regional Lanes: smaller nodes (L40x) pinned to region to reduce cross-region egress.
Batch/Offline: elastic jobs scheduled on leftovers or separate cluster with GPU sharing through q2 windows.
node_catalog:
Catalog (unit entries):
- a100-80: 1 unit = 1 A100-80GB node, throughput est interactive = 120 tokens/sec, cost basis = $/unit (capex amortized)
- h200-80: 1 unit = H200 80GB, throughput est interactive = 95 tokens/sec, cheaper per-token under batching
- l40x-48: 1 unit = L40x 48GB, throughput est interactive = 55 tokens/sec, used for region-localization
Note: throughput numbers are conservative; actual kernel profiles vary by model and seq-len. Use per-model calibration sheet for final conversion.
provisioning_matrix:
Regional provisioning matrix (summary lines)
Columns: region | target-active-units | hot-spare-units(5%) | surge-buffer-units(10%/20%/30% depending) | recommended-node-mix | ops-window-notes
east-us | 120 active | 6 hot-spares | 18 surge@15% | mix: 60% a100-80 / 30% h200 / 10% l40x | staggered replenishment monthly; prefer local hot-swaps during PST night
west-eu | 70 active | 4 hot-spares | 14 surge@20% | mix: 50% h200 / 30% a100 / 20% l40x | procurement lead-time EU 8-10 weeks; keep higher spare ratio
apac | 30 active | 2 hot-spares | 9 surge@30% | mix: 40% l40x / 40% h200 / 20% a100 | priority for edge-localization; consider short-term rentals for campaign spikes
Notes: surge buffer percentages tuned per business continuity needs — EU and APAC have more conservative buffers due to procurement/transport delays.
bom_estimates:
High-level BOM (phased):
Phase 0 (0-3 months): replenish hot-spares, on-hand spares per region.
- east-us: 6 nodes (mix: 4 a100, 1 h200, 1 l40x)
- west-eu: 4 nodes (mix: 2 h200, 1 a100, 1 l40x)
- apac: 2 nodes (mix: 1 l40x, 1 h200)
Phase 1 (3-9 months): stage surge buffer to reach target surge capacity, split in two tranches.
Phase 2 (9-18 months): capacity ramp for forecasted usage growth (20-30% headroom) and replacement cycle for earliest equipment.
Line-item cost estimation template (per node): node_model | unit_cost_usd | cabling | rack_space_u | power_kw | shipping_tax | lead_time_weeks
Sample entries (placeholder): a100-80 | 42,000 | 800 | 3U | 2.8kW | 6% | 10w
h200-80 | 34,000 | 600 | 2U | 2.4kW | 6% | 8w
l40x-48 | 18,000 | 400 | 2U | 1.6kW | 6% | 6w
Total BOM rough (phase 1): east-us 18 units * mix-weighted-cost = $X (detailed calc sheet attached as linked artifact).
ops_playbook_quick_checks:
Hot-swap checklist (ops):
- Pre-check: verify spare firmware/drivers match active fleet image; run smoke-runner; pre-seed KV-cache benchmark.
- Swap: cordon node in scheduler, drain queued work, warm-up caches on spare node (run known 10-min synthetic workload), switch routing.
- Post-swap: monitor p50/p95 for 30m; if degradation, rollback and open incident.
Rotation cadence: rotate one spare unit per region per quarter for burn-in and to detect early hardware faults.
Procurement escalation: if lead_time > 8w and utilization > 85% for 2 contiguous weeks, raise urgent purchase (ops tag urgent-procurement) and evaluate short-term colocation rentals.
sizing_formulas_and_examples:
Example conversions (text form):
- tokens/sec requirement = target_rps * avg_tokens_per_request / (1 - cache_hit_rate)
- node_count = ceil(tokens/sec requirement / node_tokens_per_sec)
Example: east-us peak target_rps 600, avg_tokens 40, cache 18% -> tokens/sec = 600*40/(1-0.18)=29268 tokens/sec. Using a100-80 at 120 tokens/sec -> 244 nodes (but interactive lanes require prioritization; convert to concurrent allocation and sharding logic).
Important: this sheet is conservative (no model-quantization uplift). Final should integrate model-specific perf numbers from model-onboarding sheet.
